icons.name: airplane
icons.heading: Airplane
icons.description: The plane takes off. Light: it turns its nose 35° toward the upper right and accelerates out along it, laying a contrail from each wingtip and the tail, and fades before the edge; the contrails hang until it returns; it glides back in from the lower left on the same line, levels off and lands on its rest pose with a small overshoot. Strong: a short draw-back first, a faster launch with contrails twice as long, and a landing that overshoots and settles in two beats.
